Mean acceleration vs shear/turbulence/pressure scales; marks throat acceleration and lagged detached shear in converging-diverging channel.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas unit-checked: Pk/eps [L2/T3]/[L2/T3]=1; UgradP/(|UgradP|+omega*k) [L2/T3]/[L2/T3]=1; DUDt/(DUDt+Snorm*Umag) [L/T2]/[L/T2]=1, so invariant to V*2 L*3. Denominators >0 in cell centers (k>0, omega>0, Umag>0) so finite on >>99%; no log/exp blow-up. Distinct from q_pgrad/q_pnorm/q_tscale: magnitude-based APG vs alignment, acceleration vs shear (not pressure), raw Pk/eps vs strain-scale; bounded forms avoid wall/freestream singularities.

features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio; marks separation/shear layers where SST anisotropy is most wrong.

features.name: f_pg_shear

features.name: f_len_wall

features.name: f_curv_omega

features.name: f_wall_turb
features.rationale: Turbulent velocity over wall-frequency scale; distinguishes near-wall damped versus free-shear regions where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_prod_eff

features.name: f_apg_shear

features: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Snorm * Umag + omega * sqrt(k) + gradp_mag)
UgradK / (abs(UgradK) + abs(UgradP) + omega * k + Snorm * k)

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless by L-T unit check (L/T^2, L^2/T^2, L^2/T^3 groups). Denominators >0 off-wall (omega*sqrt(k), k/tau, gradp terms); 0/0 only at no-slip wall where Umag=k=nut=d=0 (<1% points) so finite on >=99%. None is constant and none is a pure function of I1/I2 (use DUDt_mag, d, gradp_mag, UgradK, tau_dev) so they add info beyond I1/I2/q_ti/f_noneq. Bounded/sign-aware forms survive x/(|x|+median) mapping. Risk: f_pg_stress large in freestream with large d mitigated by mapping; f_accel/f_kadv overlap partly with f_apg_shear/f_prod_eff which are dropped as gain<=0.

Denominators >0 in interior (Snorm*k+eps>0, omega*d>0, shear+turb>0) so finite on >99% cell-centers; bounded to [-1,1]/[0,1] to avoid outliers. f_apg adds missing signed UgradP (APG>0 vs throat FPG<0) orthogonal to unsigned f_accel; f_wall adds missing d-dependence for near-wall vs free shear orthogonal to f_srat; f_pgrad adds missing gradp_mag balance. proposal.risk_audit: All three formulas checked L-T units invariant under U->2U, L->3L (numerator and denominator scale identically: a^3/b for f_apg, a^2 for others). Denominators contain strictly positive eps term (eps/(Snorm+omega)>0) so finite everywhere except possible 0/0 avoided; bounded in [-1,1] or [0,1) so not constant and robust to median normalization. f_apg signed to separate APG/FPG; f_pgwall adds d-weighting distinct from f_apg; f_aniso uses tau_dev magnitude distinct from timescale features. Drop only f_wall (negative gain and in-use) and retain zero-gain unused f_curv/f_noneq/f_trans for another search round to avoid churn; 10 free slots so no capacity risk.

features.name: f_apg

features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy magnitude fraction; tells search where SST deviatoric stress is already large and needs correction.
